title: Authoritative multiplayer for an idle ARPG, built with Opus 5.5.  The same sim runs on the phone and on the server.
author: MightyBig-Dev
selftext:
Working on an idle ARPG, so the hero fights on its own. Phones only send orders (move, gear, spells, invite). So the server runs the world, there’s no client prediction, and lag barely matters.

* One sim.ts, two homes: offline it runs on the phone, online it’s the authoritative Node server
* The refactor that made it work: everything that was “the hero” became a Hero record, and the sim steps each hero’s turn as sim.cur. Single-player is the same code w/ 1 hero; the old headless test runs came out identical
* 1 sim per channel (up to 30 players) @ 30Hz, 10Hz delta snapshots of what’s within 42m, over compressed WS
* Heroes never log out: close the app and yours keeps farming at 1/3 rate. Worlds w/ nobody playing aren’t stepped at all
* Server keeps the true save and checks every save the phone sends
* 30 players ≈ 1.7ms of a 33ms tick on a GCP e2-micro (free tier). The only bill is the static IP, $3.65/mo

Been an excellent hobby project since Canadian Thanksgiving.  Just sharing as info - took a little while to dial in this setup.

comments.author: Sara_KumoDeck
comments.body: does the server keep simulating heroes while players are offline, or only on connect?

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: All server. Loots while you’re offline. Once a hero is created they battle indefinitely. When you’re actually playing the game you get more loot, more XP and more control of your hero and abilities.
